paths.name: @prisma/client
paths.message: Do not instantiate PrismaClient. Platform code uses '@/platform/db'; apps use the `tx` from defineAction().

paths.name: @prisma/client
paths.message: Apps may not import @prisma/client. Use the `tx` passed to your defineAction() handler; import types from '@/platform/types'.

paths.name: @/platform/db
paths.message: Apps may not import the platform DB client. Use the `tx` passed to your defineAction() handler.

paths.name: @/platform/audit
paths.message: Apps may not write audit events directly. Declare `audit` in defineAction() and call ctx.recordAudit().

patterns.message: Apps may only touch the DB via the `tx` from defineAction(), and audit via ctx.recordAudit().

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw SQL is not allowed in apps. Use the Prisma query API on `tx`.
defineAction() already runs your handler in a transaction.
Apps may not access the AuditEvent table. Use ctx.recordAudit().
